outputs.explanation: Panel A shows an H&E histology image alongside spatial transcriptomics heatmap overlays on tissue sections (Log2 expression color scale), not a bar/summary plot of averaged data requiring individual point overlay.
Panel B consists of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel C is a scatter/dot plot in which every individual patient tumor value (n=512 LUAD, n=500 LUSC) is plotted, with median and 95% CI overlaid. Scatter plots inherently show individual data points, so this is exempt from requiring additional overlay.

Panel D is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of Tmprss11b expression, but individual data points (n=3 replicates per group) are overlaid as dots on each bar, satisfying the requirement to show underlying individual measurements.
